## PCI-DSS v4.0: Cardholder Data Detector

Pre-inference guardrail implementing PCI-DSS v4.0 Requirement 3. Scans and masks cardholder data in the user prompt before it reaches the LLM, then returns the sanitized response with audit headers.

**Detects and masks:** Visa / Mastercard / Amex / Discover PANs (formatted and unformatted) · CVV/CVC/CID security codes · Card expiry dates (MM/YY and MM/YYYY)

**Response includes:** `X-PCI-Scan: masked | clean` · `X-PCI-Redaction-Count: N` · full `pci_scan` object in body

**Built by** [Neville Ko](https://www.linkedin.com/in/nevilleko/) · [GitHub](https://github.com/nenedesign)

## Prerequisites

1. An LLM API that accepts OpenAI-compatible `messages` format
2. A Bearer token for that API: add it as the **LLM API Key** credential on the **Forward to LLM API** node

**Test with:**
```
POST /webhook-test/pci-cardholder-scan
{
  "user_input": "my card is 4111 1111 1111 1111 cvv 123",
  "user_id": "test-user"
}
```
Expected: `[CARD-REDACTED]` and `[CVV-REDACTED]` in `sanitized_input`

## Configuration

Two placeholders to replace in the **Forward to LLM API** node:

- **URL**: your LLM API endpoint
  e.g. `https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions`
- **Model**: your model name
  e.g. `gpt-4o` or `claude-opus-4-5-20251101`

The **Respond with LLM Output** node reads `$json.choices[0].message.content`. Update this path if your LLM returns a different response structure.
